subject: Paradise rocks
author: Xandu
body:
Im really excited about Burnout Paradise. It sounds really good. I like the idea of it being open and free and that you choose what and when you want to do. They call it "Your Burnout" and I think that will be the biggest change as all the previous Burnouts have been Criterion's Burnout. By that I mean that there has been very little room for customizations.

-- The Creator --
